content: {"sql": "SELECT name AS 厂站名称, capacity_m3d AS 设计处理规模_立方米每日 FROM plant WHERE name LIKE '%南郑中心%' LIMIT 10", "explanation": "按名称关键字匹配南郑中心污水处理厂，直接取 plant 表中的设计处理规模字段。"}
{"sql": "SELECT name AS 厂站名称, code AS 厂站编码, kind AS 厂站类型, capacity_m3d AS 设计规模_m3d FROM plant WHERE process = '氧化沟' ORDER BY code", "explanation": "从 plant 表中筛选处理工艺为氧化沟的厂站并列出名称、编码、类型和规模。"}

{"sql": "SELECT count(*) AS 鼓风机总台数, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = '备用') AS 备用台数, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = '运行') AS 运行台数, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = '检修') AS 检修台数, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = '故障') AS 故障台数 FROM device WHERE kind = '鼓风机'", "explanation": "在设备台账中筛选类型为鼓风机的设备，统计总台数并按状态统计备用台数等。"}

{"sql": "SELECT name AS 厂站名称, code AS 厂站编码, capacity_m3d AS 设计规模_立方米每日, process AS 处理工艺 FROM plant WHERE kind = '集镇厂' ORDER BY capacity_m3d DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "在 plant 表中筛选 kind='集镇厂' 的厂站，按设计规模 capacity_m3d 降序取第一条即可得到规模最大的集镇厂。"}
{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(capacity_m3d)::numeric, 0) AS 设计规模合计_立方米每日, count(*) AS 厂站数量 FROM plant", "explanation": "对 plant 表所有厂站的设计处理规模求和并统计厂站数量。"}
{"sql": "SELECT kind AS 设备类型, count(*) AS 设备数量, round(sum(rated_kw)::numeric, 2) AS 总额定功率_kW FROM device GROUP BY kind ORDER BY 设备数量 DESC", "explanation": "按设备类型分组统计设备台账中的设备数量与额定功率合计。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, d.code AS 设备编码, d.kind AS 设备类型, d.model AS 型号, d.rated_kw AS 额定功率, d.status AS 状态 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山%' ORDER BY d.code LIMIT 100", "explanation": "按厂站名称模糊匹配梁山镇污水处理站，关联设备台账列出设备编码与类型等信息。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, d.code AS 设备编码, d.kind AS 设备类型, d.model AS 型号, round(d.rated_kw::numeric, 1) AS 额定功率千瓦, d.status AS 当前状态 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.rated_kw IS NOT NULL AND d.rated_kw = (SELECT max(rated_kw) FROM device) ORDER BY p.code, d.code", "explanation": "在设备台账中取额定功率等于全表最大值的设备，并关联厂站名称列出明细。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(r.inflow_m3h::numeric, 1) AS 进水流量_立方米每小时, r.ts AS 采集时间 FROM plant p JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ts, inflow_m3h FROM plant_reading WHERE plant_id = p.id ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) r ON TRUE WHERE p.kind = '中心厂';", "explanation": "按中心厂类型匹配厂站，取 plant_reading 中该厂最新一条记录的进水瞬时流量（m³/h）。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 采集时间, round(r.mlss::numeric, 0) AS 污泥浓度MLSS_mgL FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' ORDER BY r.ts DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "从分钟级实时表 plant_reading 取协税镇最新一条记录的 MLSS 值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, round(r.do_aerobic_1::numeric, 2) AS 好氧区1号溶解氧, round(r.do_aerobic_2::numeric, 2) AS 好氧区2号溶解氧, r.ts AS 采集时间 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (plant_id) plant_id, ts, do_aerobic_1, do_aerobic_2 FROM plant_reading WHERE ts > now() - interval '1 day' ORDER BY plant_id, ts DESC) r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "在 plant_reading 中按厂站取最近一条记录，得到各厂好氧区 1/2 号最新溶解氧值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(inflow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 昨日处理水量_立方米 FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND hour < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "汇总全部厂站昨天自然日 24 个小时的小时处理水量，得到全区昨日总处理水量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, d.kind AS 设备类型, d.status AS 设备状态, round(dr.current_a::numeric, 2) AS 运行电流_A, dr.running AS 是否运行, to_char(dr.ts, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS 采集时间 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ts, current_a, running FROM device_reading WHERE device_id = d.id ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) dr ON true WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND d.code = 'P01-BL-1'", "explanation": "按厂站名称匹配中心厂、设备编码 P01-BL-1 定位 1 号鼓风机，取该设备最新一条运行监测记录中的电流值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(sum(r.blower_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 鼓风机耗电量_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.kind = '中心厂' AND r.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.name", "explanation": "筛选中心厂昨天自然日的小时均值数据，累加 blower_kw（数值等于该小时耗电量 kWh）得到鼓风机总耗电量。"}

{"sql":"WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (plant_id) plant_id, ts, tn_out
  FROM plant_reading
  ORDER BY plant_id, ts DESC
)
SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称,
       round(l.tn_out::numeric, 2) AS 出水总氮_mgL,
       l.ts AS 采集时间
FROM latest l
JOIN plant p ON p.id = l.plant_id
WHERE l.tn_out IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY l.tn_out DESC
LIMIT 1;","explanation":"取各厂站最新一条实时数据中的出水总氮，并按数值降序取最高者。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(sum(r.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 处理水量_立方米 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND r.hour < now() GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 处理水量_立方米 DESC", "explanation": "统计本周一至今各厂小时处理水量之和，按厂站分组并降序排列。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(r.cod_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水COD日均值, round(avg(r.nh3n_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水氨氮日均值, round(avg(r.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水总氮日均值, round(avg(r.tp_out)::numeric, 3) AS 出水总磷日均值, round(sum(r.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND r.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.name", "explanation": "按中心厂筛选昨天整天的 1 小时均值数据，对出水 COD、氨氮、总氮、总磷的小时均值取日均值，并汇总处理水量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, round(avg(r.nh3n_in)::numeric, 2) AS 平均进水氨氮_mgL, count(*) AS 统计小时数 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 平均进水氨氮_mgL DESC", "explanation": "从小时均值表取最近24小时数据，按厂站分组求进水氨氮平均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(r.cod_in)::numeric, 2) AS 进水COD平均值_mgL, count(*) AS 小时样本数 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND r.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) AND r.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) + interval '12 hours' GROUP BY p.name", "explanation": "取今天 0 点至 12 点（上午）中心厂的小时均值数据，对进水 COD 求平均。"}

{"sql": "WITH daily AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', r.hour) AS d, sum(r.inflow_m3h) AS m3
  FROM plant_reading_1h r
  JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id
  WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山%'
    AND r.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '6 days'
    AND r.hour < date_trunc('day', now())
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT round(sum(m3)::numeric, 1) AS 总处理水量,
       round((sum(m3) / 6)::numeric, 1) AS 日均处理水量
FROM daily;", "explanation": "筛选梁山镇污水处理站 10月30日至11月4日（即今天前6个自然日）的小时水量，按天汇总后求6天日均处理水量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(carbon_dose_kgh)::numeric, 1) AS 碳源投加量_kg, round(sum(pac_dose_kgh)::numeric, 1) AS PAC投加量_kg FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND hour < now()", "explanation": "对本周边界至今所有厂站小时均值的碳源、PAC 投加量（kg/h）求和，得到全区累计投加公斤数。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(max(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 最高气温, round(min(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 最低气温 FROM weather WHERE ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND ts < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "统计昨天自然日（0 点至今日 0 点）气象数据中气温的最大值和最小值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(blower_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 鼓风机总耗电量_kWh, round(sum(inflow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 处理水量_m3, round((sum(blower_kw) / nullif(sum(inflow_m3h), 0))::numeric, 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh每m3 FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND hour < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "汇总昨天全部厂站小时表的鼓风机功率（即耗电量）与处理水量，相除得到吨水曝气电耗。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(r.mlss)::numeric, 1) AS 平均污泥浓度_mgL, count(r.mlss) AS 样本数 FROM plant p JOIN plant_reading r ON r.plant_id = p.id WHERE r.ts >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.ts < now() AND r.mlss IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 平均污泥浓度_mgL DESC", "explanation": "小时聚合表 plant_reading_1h 不含 MLSS 字段，故直接查原始表 plant_reading，按厂站统计最近 7 天好氧池 MLSS 的平均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(r.air_flow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 平均曝气风量_m3h FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND r.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.name", "explanation": "筛选中心厂昨天(前一个自然日)的小时数据，对曝气风量 air_flow_m3h 求平均。"}

{"sql": "SELECT to_char(hour, 'HH24:00') AS 时间, round(sum(inflow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) AND hour < now() GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour", "explanation": "按今天零点到现在，对 plant_reading_1h 按整点分组汇总所有厂站的进水流量（即各小时处理水量）。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, to_char(h.hour, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:00') AS 时间, round(avg(h.tp_out)::numeric, 3) AS 出水总磷均值 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND h.hour >= timestamptz '2026-11-03 00:00:00+08' AND h.hour < timestamptz '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' GROUP BY p.name, h.hour ORDER BY h.hour", "explanation": "在小时聚合表中按厂站名称模糊匹配协税镇，筛选 11 月 3 日当天各整点并输出出水总磷小时均值。"}

{"sql": "WITH d AS (SELECT date_trunc('day', pr.hour) AS day, sum(pr.blower_kw) AS kwh, sum(pr.inflow_m3h) AS m3 FROM plant_reading_1h pr JOIN plant p ON p.id = pr.plant_id WHERE p.kind = '中心厂' AND pr.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND pr.hour < now() GROUP BY 1) SELECT to_char(day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS 日期, round(m3::numeric, 0) AS 处理水量m3, round(kwh::numeric, 1) AS 曝气耗电量kWh, round((kwh / NULLIF(m3, 0))::numeric, 3) AS 吨水曝气电耗 FROM d ORDER BY day", "explanation": "按本周起始时间过滤中心厂的小时数据，按自然日汇总鼓风机耗电量与处理水量并计算吨水曝气电耗。"}

{"sql":"SELECT date_trunc('day', ts)::date AS 日期, round(avg(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 平均气温 FROM weather WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' AND ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 00:00:00+08' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1","explanation":"查询 11 月 1 日至 11 月 4 日的气象数据，按自然日分组计算平均气温。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, round(avg(r.cod_out)::numeric, 2) AS 平均出水COD_mgL, round(avg(r.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 平均小时处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.cod_out IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 平均出水COD_mgL DESC LIMIT 10", "explanation": "按厂站统计最近7天 plant_reading_1h 中出水COD的小时均值再取平均，按平均值降序排列取最高者。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, round(sum(r.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 处理水量立方米 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY sum(r.inflow_m3h) DESC LIMIT 3", "explanation": "按昨天自然日范围汇总各厂站小时表的进水流量（即处理水量），降序取前三名。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, round(sum(r.carbon_dose_kgh)::numeric, 1) AS 碳源投加量_kg, round(sum(r.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 处理水量_m3, round((sum(r.carbon_dose_kgh) / NULLIF(sum(r.inflow_m3h), 0))::numeric, 5) AS 吨水碳源投加量_kg_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.hour < now() GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 吨水碳源投加量_kg_m3 DESC", "explanation": "按厂站汇总最近7天碳源投加量（sum(carbon_dose_kgh)，kg）与处理水量（sum(inflow_m3h)，m³），两者相除得吨水碳源投加量并降序排列。"}

{"sql":"SELECT p.name AS 厂站, h.hour AS 时间, round(h.cod_out::numeric, 2) AS 出水COD FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND h.hour <= now() ORDER BY h.cod_out DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1","explanation":"查询最近7天小时均值数据，按出水COD降序取最高的一小时，并关联厂站名称。"}

{"sql": "SELECT date_trunc('day', hour)::date AS \"日期\", round(sum(inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS \"处理水量(m³)\" FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND hour < now() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sum(inflow_m3h) DESC LIMIT 1;", "explanation": "按天汇总最近7天全区各厂站小时处理水量，取总量最大的一天。"}

{"sql":"SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, count(*) AS 超标小时数, round(max(pr.nh3n_out_max)::numeric, 2) AS 最高出水氨氮_mgL, to_char(max(pr.hour), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:00') AS 最近超标时间 FROM plant_reading_1h pr JOIN plant p ON p.id = pr.plant_id WHERE pr.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND pr.nh3n_out_max > 5 GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY 最高出水氨氮_mgL DESC;","explanation":"统计最近7天内小时均值表中出水氨氮最大值超过一级A标准5 mg/L的厂站，并汇总超标小时数、最高值和最近超标时间。"}

{"sql": "WITH weekly AS (SELECT r.plant_id, p.name AS plant_name, sum(r.blower_kw) AS blower_kwh, sum(r.inflow_m3h) AS inflow_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND r.hour <= now() GROUP BY r.plant_id, p.name HAVING sum(r.inflow_m3h) > 0) SELECT plant_name AS 厂站名称, round((blower_kwh / inflow_m3)::numeric, 4) AS \"吨水曝气电耗(kWh/m³)\" FROM weekly ORDER BY blower_kwh / inflow_m3 ASC LIMIT 2", "explanation": "按本周整点小时数据汇总各厂鼓风机耗电量与处理水量，计算吨水曝气电耗并取最低的两个厂。"}

{"sql":"WITH day_range AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AS start_ts,
         date_trunc('day', now()) AS end_ts
)
SELECT
  p.name AS 厂站,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.nh3n_out_max > 5) AS 氨氮超标小时数,
  round(max(r.nh3n_out_max)::numeric, 2) AS 最高氨氮_mgL
FROM plant p
JOIN plant_reading_1h r ON r.plant_id = p.id
CROSS JOIN day_range d
WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%'
  AND r.hour >= d.start_ts
  AND r.hour < d.end_ts
GROUP BY p.name;","explanation":"查询黄官镇污水站11月4日小时均值数据，按出水氨氮小时最大值超过一级A标准5 mg/L的小时计数，并取当日最高值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(avg(r.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水总氮平均值, round(max(r.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水总氮最大小时均值 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND r.hour >= now() - interval '7 days'", "explanation": "从小时均值表取中心厂最近7天出水总氮，同时计算时段平均值和小时均值的最大值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS \"厂站\", pr.hour AS \"首次超标时间\", round(pr.tp_out_max::numeric, 3) AS \"出水总磷最大值(mg/L)\" FROM plant_reading_1h pr JOIN plant p ON p.id = pr.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND pr.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND pr.hour < now() AND pr.tp_out_max > 0.5 ORDER BY pr.hour ASC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "按本周（周一起）筛选协税镇小时数据中出水总磷最大值超过一级A标准 0.5 mg/L 的记录，按时间升序取第一条，即本周首次超标时刻。"}

{"sql": "SELECT count(*) AS 超标小时数 FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND hour < now() AND tp_out_max > 0.5;", "explanation": "统计本周以来所有厂站小时均值数据中出水总磷最大值超过一级A标准0.5 mg/L的小时记录数。"}

{"sql": "WITH bad AS (
  SELECT plant_id, count(*) AS bad_hours
  FROM plant_reading_1h
  WHERE hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day'
    AND hour < date_trunc('day', now())
    AND (cod_out > 50 OR nh3n_out_max > 5 OR tn_out > 15 OR tp_out_max > 0.5 OR ss_out > 10)
  GROUP BY plant_id
)
SELECT p.name AS 厂站,
       COALESCE(b.bad_hours, 0) AS 出水超标小时数
FROM plant p
LEFT JOIN bad b ON b.plant_id = p.id
ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "以昨天整日的小时均值数据按厂统计任一指标（COD>50、氨氮最大值>5、总氮>15、总磷最大值>0.5、SS>10）超标的小时数，并用 LEFT JOIN 保证未超标厂也列出为 0。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, d.code AS 设备编码, d.model AS 型号, d.rated_kw AS 额定功率_kW, d.status AS 状态 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.kind = '鼓风机' AND d.status = '备用' ORDER BY p.code, d.code", "explanation": "在设备台账中筛选类型为鼓风机且状态为备用的设备，关联厂站表输出所属厂站名称。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, round(max(dr.vibration_mms)::numeric, 2) AS 最大振动_mm_s FROM device_reading dr JOIN device d ON d.id = dr.device_id JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.kind = '鼓风机' AND dr.ts >= now() - interval '7 days' AND dr.vibration_mms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.name, d.code ORDER BY max(dr.vibration_mms) DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "筛选过去7天鼓风机的设备监测数据，按设备分组取最大振动值并倒序取第一台。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, d.model AS 型号, count(r.ts) AS 监测点数, round(avg(r.temp_c)::numeric, 2) AS 平均轴承温度_摄氏度, round(max(r.temp_c)::numeric, 2) AS 最高温度_摄氏度, round(avg(r.vibration_mms)::numeric, 2) AS 平均振动_mms FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id LEFT JOIN device_reading r ON r.device_id = d.id AND r.ts >= now() - interval '24 hours' WHERE p.kind = '中心厂' AND d.kind = '鼓风机' AND d.status = '运行' GROUP BY p.name, d.code, d.model ORDER BY d.code", "explanation": "筛选中心厂状态为运行中的鼓风机，关联过去24小时设备监测数据，按设备统计平均与最高轴承温度。"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, d.kind AS 设备类型, round(avg(dr.current_a)::numeric, 2) AS 平均电流_A, count(*) AS 运行采样点数 FROM device d JOIN device_reading dr ON dr.device_id = d.id JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND d.kind = '提升泵' AND dr.running = true AND dr.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND dr.ts < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY d.code, d.kind ORDER BY d.code LIMIT 20", "explanation": "在中心厂设备台账中筛出提升泵，关联昨天的设备监测数据，只取运行状态记录，按设备求平均电流。"}

{"sql":"SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT dr.running) AS 停机分钟数 FROM plant p JOIN device d ON d.plant_id = p.id JOIN device_reading dr ON dr.device_id = d.id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官镇%' AND d.code = 'P06-BL-1' AND dr.ts >= timestamptz '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' AND dr.ts < timestamptz '2026-11-05 00:00:00+08' GROUP BY p.name, d.code;","explanation":"筛选黄官镇污水站1号鼓风机（P06-BL-1）在2026年11月4日全天的分钟级监测记录，统计 running=false 的分钟数作为停机分钟数。"}

{"sql":"SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, min(r.ts) AS 首次超过7_1时间 FROM device_reading r JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND d.kind = '鼓风机' AND d.code = 'P06-BL-1' AND r.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.ts < date_trunc('day', now()) AND r.vibration_mms > 7.1 GROUP BY p.name, d.code;","explanation":"在黄官镇污水站1号鼓风机11月4日的监测数据中，筛选振动值首次超过7.1 mm/s的最早时间。"}

{"sql": "WITH r AS (
  SELECT ts, rain_mm_h
  FROM weather
  WHERE ts >= timestamptz '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08'
    AND ts <  timestamptz '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08'
    AND rain_mm_h > 0
)
SELECT
  to_char(min(ts) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS 降雨开始时间,
  to_char(max(ts) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' + interval '1 hour', 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS 降雨结束时间,
  count(*) AS 降雨小时数,
  round(sum(rain_mm_h)::numeric, 1) AS 累计降雨量毫米
FROM r;", "explanation": "从气象表筛选 2026-10-31 当天降雨强度大于 0 的记录，取最早时刻为降雨开始、最晚时刻加 1 小时为降雨结束，并汇总降雨量与小时数。"}

{"sql": "WITH d AS (
  SELECT ts, rain_mm_h
  FROM weather
  WHERE ts >= date_trunc('day', timestamptz '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08')
    AND ts <  date_trunc('day', timestamptz '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08') + interval '1 day'
)
SELECT round(max(rain_mm_h)::numeric, 2) AS "最大降雨强度(mm/h)",
       to_char((SELECT ts FROM d ORDER BY rain_mm_h DESC LIMIT 1), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "出现时间",
       round(sum(rain_mm_h)::numeric, 1) AS "当日累计降雨量(mm)"
FROM d;", "explanation": "从气象表 weather 中筛选 2026-10-31 全天记录，取 rain_mm_h 的最大值、对应时刻及当日累计降雨量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS "厂站", d.code AS "设备编码", count(dr.ts) FILTER (WHERE dr.running) AS "运行分钟数"
FROM device d
JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id
LEFT JOIN device_reading dr
  ON dr.device_id = d.id
 AND dr.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day'
 AND dr.ts < date_trunc('day', now())
WHERE d.kind = '污泥泵'
GROUP BY p.name, d.code
ORDER BY p.name, d.code;", "explanation": "按厂站和污泥泵设备编码统计昨天运行记录数，设备数据每分钟一条，故 running 为真的记录数即运行分钟数。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(min(r.do_aerobic_1)::numeric, 2) AS 好氧区1号最低溶解氧, round(min(r.do_aerobic_2)::numeric, 2) AS 好氧区2号最低溶解氧, (array_agg(r.ts ORDER BY r.do_aerobic_1 ASC))[1] AS 最低值出现时间, count(*) AS 采样点数 FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND r.ts >= timestamptz '2026-11-04 15:00:00+08' AND r.ts < timestamptz '2026-11-04 18:00:00+08' GROUP BY p.name", "explanation": "在原始表 plant_reading 中取黄官镇污水站 11月4日15:00-18:00 的分钟级数据，统计好氧区溶解氧最小值及出现时间。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(max(r.tp_out_max)::numeric, 3) AS 出水总磷最高值_mgL, to_char(date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '2 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS 统计日期 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND r.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '2 days' AND r.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' GROUP BY p.name", "explanation": "在小时聚合表中筛选协税镇污水处理站 11 月 3 日全天（昨天再往前一天）的数据，取该日出水总磷小时最大值 tp_out_max 的最大值作为当日最高排放浓度。"}

{"sql":"SELECT p.name AS 厂站,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN h.hour >= timestamptz '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' AND h.hour < timestamptz '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' THEN h.inflow_m3h ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 0) AS "10月31日处理水量",
       round(sum(CASE WHEN h.hour >= timestamptz '2026-10-30 00:00:00+08' AND h.hour < timestamptz '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' THEN h.inflow_m3h ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 0) AS "10月30日处理水量",
       round((sum(CASE WHEN h.hour >= timestamptz '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' AND h.hour < timestamptz '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' THEN h.inflow_m3h ELSE 0 END)
             - sum(CASE WHEN h.hour >= timestamptz '2026-10-30 00:00:00+08' AND h.hour < timestamptz '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' THEN h.inflow_m3h ELSE 0 END))::numeric, 0) AS 增加量
FROM plant_reading_1h h
JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山镇%'
  AND h.hour >= timestamptz '2026-10-30 00:00:00+08'
  AND h.hour < timestamptz '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08'
GROUP BY p.name;","explanation":"统计梁山镇污水站 10 月 31 日与 10 月 30 日的日处理水量，并计算两天差值。"}

{"sql":"WITH b AS (SELECT date_trunc('day', now()) AS today), s AS (SELECT sum(CASE WHEN hour >= b.today - interval '1 day' AND hour < b.today THEN inflow_m3h END) AS yesterday_m3, sum(CASE WHEN hour >= b.today - interval '2 days' AND hour < b.today - interval '1 day' THEN inflow_m3h END) AS before_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h, b) SELECT round(yesterday_m3::numeric, 1) AS 昨天处理水量_m3, round(before_m3::numeric, 1) AS 前天处理水量_m3, round((yesterday_m3 - before_m3)::numeric, 1) AS 增加水量_m3 FROM s;","explanation":"汇总全部厂站昨天与前天的 plant_reading_1h 小时处理水量，并计算差值。"}

{"sql": "WITH t AS (SELECT sum(r.inflow_m3h) FILTER (WHERE p.kind = '中心厂') AS 中心厂水量, sum(r.inflow_m3h) AS 全区水量 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.hour < now()) SELECT round(中心厂水量::numeric, 1) AS 中心厂处理水量m3, round(全区水量::numeric, 1) AS 全区处理水量m3, round((中心厂水量 / NULLIF(全区水量, 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS 占比百分比 FROM t;", "explanation": "统计过去7天全部厂站及中心厂的小时处理水量合计，两者相除得到中心厂占比。"}

{"sql": "WITH t AS (SELECT p.name, sum(r.inflow_m3h) AS q, sum(r.tn_in * r.inflow_m3h) AS tn_in_load, sum(r.tn_out * r.inflow_m3h) AS tn_out_load FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.hour < date_trunc('hour', now()) AND r.inflow_m3h IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.name) SELECT name AS 厂站, round(q::numeric, 0) AS 处理水量m3, round((tn_in_load / nullif(q,0))::numeric, 2) AS 进水总氮均值, round((tn_out_load / nullif(q,0))::numeric, 2) AS 出水总氮均值, round(((tn_in_load - tn_out_load) / nullif(tn_in_load,0) * 100)::numeric, 1) AS 总氮去除率百分比 FROM t ORDER BY 总氮去除率百分比 DESC", "explanation": "取最近7天小时均值数据，按厂站以处理水量为权重计算进出水总氮负荷，得出各厂总氮去除率百分比。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, p.capacity_m3d AS 设计规模_m3d, round(sum(r.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 昨日处理水量_m3, round((sum(r.inflow_m3h) / p.capacity_m3d * 100)::numeric, 1) AS 负荷率_百分比 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.capacity_m3d ORDER BY 负荷率_百分比 DESC", "explanation": "用小时聚合表统计昨天各厂进水量合计，除以设计规模得到负荷率百分比。"}

{"sql":"WITH daily_rain AS (SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, sum(rain_mm_h)::numeric AS rain_mm FROM weather WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days' AND ts < now() GROUP BY 1), max_day AS (SELECT day, rain_mm FROM daily_rain ORDER BY rain_mm DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) SELECT to_char(m.day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS 日期, round(m.rain_mm, 1) AS 日降雨量_毫米, round(sum(r.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 全区处理水量_立方米 FROM max_day m JOIN plant_reading_1h r ON date_trunc('day', r.hour) = m.day GROUP BY m.day, m.rain_mm;","explanation":"按自然日汇总过去7天降雨量，取累计降雨量最大的一天，再汇总该日各厂站小时处理水量。"}

{"sql": "WITH plant_avg AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.name, avg(r.cod_in) AS avg_cod
  FROM plant p
  JOIN plant_reading_1h r ON r.plant_id = p.id
  WHERE r.hour >= now() - interval '7 days'
    AND r.hour <= now()
    AND r.cod_in IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.id, p.name
), overall AS (
  SELECT avg(cod_in) AS avg_all
  FROM plant_reading_1h
  WHERE hour >= now() - interval '7 days'
    AND hour <= now()
    AND cod_in IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT pa.name AS 厂站,
       round(pa.avg_cod::numeric, 2) AS 过去7天平均进水COD,
       round(o.avg_all::numeric, 2) AS 全区平均进水COD
FROM plant_avg pa
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE pa.avg_cod > o.avg_all
ORDER BY pa.avg_cod DESC;", "explanation": "按厂站统计过去7天小时表进水COD均值，并与同期全区总平均比较，筛出高于全区平均的厂站。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.process AS 工艺类型, round(sum(r.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 处理水量_m3, count(DISTINCT p.id) AS 厂站数 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.process ORDER BY 处理水量_m3 DESC", "explanation": "按工艺分组汇总昨天（前一自然日）各小时处理水量，即 sum(inflow_m3h)。"}
